model_contract.normal_forms: record tool-native definition and eigenvector normalization; no implicit l1 conversion
model_contract.arclength: record physical metric and state/parameter weights per tool
model_contract.chart_boundary: Hopf chart termination near BT is a boundary, not a BT detection

model_contract.coverage_note: BT is a refined point selected in a window; Hopf may terminate at a chart boundary, which cannot pass full-domain publication
